event_name: Time 14:02 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards have received a request from Haas F1 Team to re-scrutineer car 8 which has had a change of the survival cell. In accordance with Article 25.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards agreed that this can take place on July 7th, before Practice 3.
